settle 1000 ms, then 5000 ms idle playback (play.idle-*)
clip header drag +40 px = 1 s at 40 px/s (harness.restart-live)

rows.note: React commits seen by the devtools-hook stub in the 2 s after the Add click; a disabled hook must fail, not report 0.

rows.scenario: while playing, drag the added clip 1 s right (scheduleKey change)
rows.note: start() calls on non-offline contexts from pointerdown until the page is quiet (>= 500 ms after pointerup, 200 ms without a commit or start, cap 3 s); detail groups the calls per task; proves the restart counter is live.

rows.scenario: 1x only, after fader.group.playing and Space -> stopped: drag Pan — Music (stopped) with an injected bubble-phase window pointermove listener that busy-waits 30 ms
rows.note: Liveness: move-to-paint must count synchronous handler time. The listener is removed after the drag; values are written only to this row (R-4).

rows.scenario: 1x only, after harness.move-latency-live.sync: drag Pan — Music (stopped) with an injected window pointermove listener that posts a MessageChannel message whose handler busy-waits 30 ms
rows.note: Liveness: move-to-paint must count work deferred to a later task (as React's render is). Fails if the sampler skips its requestAnimationFrame step (red-proof, round 208).

rows.scenario: 1x only, after both injected listeners are removed: the same Pan — Music drag (stopped) without injection
rows.note: Control for the liveness rows; detail: pointermoveListenersAtStart and pointermoveListenersAfterRemoval (CDP DOMDebugger.getEventListeners on window, at rest). A count mismatch, or a control p95 >= 30 ms (the injected busy time), is a run problem.

moves-dispatched minus move-to-paint samples received (i.e. samples >= moves-dispatched - 2); detail: movesDispatched, samples. A drag with no moves cannot pass silently: the move window then reports a run problem.

move-components-max of the track-stopped drag; >= 1 proves the move window catches commits (baseline about 83). PERF-FADER-a replaces it with an equivalent proof once the volume drag stops committing per move.

ms from navigation start to ready; baseline 2.3–2.5 s (perf-plan).

Summed re-rendered components over the load commits.

Determinism-checked; must agree across 1x and 6x.

p95 over the drag's pointermoves (all moves-dispatched, including the hover move before pointerdown) of move-to-paint: t0 = performance.now() in a capture-phase window pointermove listener, then requestAnimationFrame, then a MessageChannel message; the sample is now - t0 in onmessage. Counts the handler, work deferred to later tasks (React's render) and the wait for the next frame; the end of the real paint is not measured directly. Policy target p95 < 16 ms (SABA-B-5). Wall-clock: trend only (±30 %); liveness-proved by harness.move-latency-live.*.

rows.note: Largest re-rendered component count in one commit inside the move window: commits after the first pointermove that follows the in-page pointerdown and before the in-page pointerup (capture-phase window listeners). The pointerdown commit(s) and the release commit are excluded by definition (detail: windowCommits, downCommits, downComponentsMax, movesInWindow). 0 if no commits. Target <= 3 (PERF-FADER-a/b flips to assert). Determinism-checked; must agree across 1x and 6x.
